gen-dafont-burnstown-dam-poppins: Refined and geometric, Burnstown Dam has a hairline gap like cracked porcelain and big, closed-off counters. Poppins is plain sans through and through, with rope-soft curves and no thick-thin flicker to catch the eye.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-julius-sans-one: Cowboys traces every letter at constant width, like a laser-etched line. Julius Sans One, the sans-serif here, leaves wide stretches of blank space between letters, so paragraphs would drift by slowly and lightly.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-lexend-exa: Wide gaps between neighboring stems give Cowboys a rustic, laser-etched look at constant width. But Lexend Exa, a sans with stubby ascenders and a big x-height, holds every wide curve distinct and uniform.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega looks drawn with one nib, with a visible gap at the end of every c. Lexend Mega's biggest strength here is lowercase close to capital height, set against Cowboys' widely gapped, etched stems.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-lexend-zetta: Etched lines, wide gaps, rustic weight: Cowboys looks cut rather than drawn. And where Cowboys is built to be noticed, Lexend Zetta carries the words in widely tracked, ribbon-like strokes.
gen-dafont-deutsch-gothic-poppins: Deutsch Gothic is dense and dignified, stems and curves packed close. Poppins, plain sans with rope-like curves that never knot at the ends, loosens up everything the heading packs tight.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline has round bowls of constant wall thickness and a lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals. And Vast Shadow handles the vintage, eye-catching shouting, leaving the quieter text to that lowercase.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-mozilla-headline: Every stroke, curves included, is cut to one width in Vast Shadow. Mozilla Headline, the sans-serif here, has big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, so extended text would feel friendly and unhurried.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-mozilla-text: Loud and vintage: Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to one width, hairlines absent. And Mozilla Text, a sans-serif with flared terminals and bold-looking lowercase, grounds it with a sturdier, quieter voice.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans: Single-stroke brush lettering, vintage and eye-catching: Vast Shadow keeps one constant width from every curve to every stem. Noto Sans takes the reading, its lowercase filling most of the letter height.
